published_prior_art.cite: LuedtkeVanDerLaan2016OptimalValue + standard positivity identification; the localized zero-exposure diagnostic is not located as an exact result.
PerchetRigollet2013CovariateBandits supplies the underlying Hölder-margin bandit class; the explicit compatibility witness is bookkeeping.
CaiLow2004 coverage-to-length logic plus KaufmannCappeGarivier2016 adaptive change of measure; the stated combination is routine.
SimchiLeviWang2023BanditExperimentalDesign gives the closest regret-versus-gap-estimation tradeoff; honest-width and benchmark-relative targeting are added scope.

HuKallusMao2022SmoothContextualBandits, LiShiSimchiLevi2024PrivateAdaptiveDesign, and BibautEtAl2021PostContextualBanditInference do not jointly supply continuous-context budget feasibility, local information allocation, and honest inference.

SimchiLeviWang2023BanditExperimentalDesign, LuedtkeVanDerLaan2016OptimalValue, and PraharajKhamaru2025AvoidingPriceAdaptivity leave the hard-welfare-budget, uniformly honest nonregular-width frontier unresolved.

soundness_flags.label: ass:margin
soundness_flags.one_line: The cited contextual-bandit margin condition is local in the gap radius, whereas this core labels the strictly stronger all-u>0 version standard; either restore a local radius and derive the needed extension, or retag and justify the strengthening.

soundness_flags.label: ass:gaussian-reward
soundness_flags.one_line: HanJiaoMukherjee2020LrNorms studies a Gaussian white-noise experiment, not the stated arm-specific conditional Gaussian adaptive-regression model, so it does not support this standard-tag citation.

soundness_flags.label: Open-ended Question 1: uniform budget saturation
soundness_flags.one_line: Neither an active-cell set nor a dual allocation prescribing arm-specific information is defined by the scalar modulus, so the requested guarantee has no testable mathematical predicate.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper proves a regret times expected treatment-gap estimation-error tradeoff, gives Pareto conditions, and gives Algorithm 1 a finite-sample gap-error guarantee; it does not state an honest-interval-width result.

source_verification_receipts.version: author-final v3 linked to Annals of Statistics 41(2), DOI 10.1214/13-AOS1101; publisher page was inspected but its text was inaccessible
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The source defines the margin condition only for delta in [0,delta_0], with alpha>0; its regret theorem is stated for beta in (0,1], L>0, and alpha>0.

The paper studies estimation of L_r norms of a mean in a Gaussian white-noise model over Nikolskii–Besov spaces, rather than an arm-specific conditional Gaussian regression experiment under adaptive assignment.
The article gives a pathwise-differentiability characterization for optimal value and an online one-step route to asymptotically valid two-sided inference under stated remainder conditions.
The paper establishes stability and asymptotically valid Wald inference for fixed linear functionals under penalized EXP4, alongside regret bounds up to logarithmic factors.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Define a dual relaxation of the sequential modulus, its cellwise arm-information requirements, and the active-cell predicate before retaining the saturation OEQ.
Replace the all-radius margin tag with the cited local Tsybakov condition plus an explicit derived envelope lemma, or label the global version novel and justify its practical use.
Promote the completed frontier to a named rate function and state a matched lower/upper theorem with an explicit continuous-context allocation certificate.

recommended_next_step: Revise the two unsupported standard tags and formalize the OEQ’s dual allocation predicate, then rerun novelty review.
